plan.title: Glass Orchard, 30 seconds
plan.assembly: Concept, then the shot list, then prompts, then what not to generate yet.

steps.title: Concept
steps.instructions: One paragraph and the beats. One person, night, wet pavement, one warm window. About 30 seconds. No crowd.
steps.why: This sample routes the concept to Gemini. The step is a visual mood built from the song idea, and the example treats that picture-making as Gemini's job. The model id stays example because no live model was called.
steps.output:
Glass Orchard is a 30 second walk home. One singer, coat buttoned, mouth mostly closed. The street is wet. One window is warm. No crowd, no dance, no second character.

Beats:
0 to 8 seconds: shop light goes out, door closes.
8 to 20 seconds: walk, one look back, breath you can almost see.
20 to 30 seconds: the warm window, a small stop, end on the coat and the light.

The song title in this sample is Glass Orchard by Lumen Park. Both are fictional.

steps.title: Shot list
steps.instructions: Short shots, calm motion. Mouth mostly closed. Same coat and the same warm window in every shot that shows them.
steps.why: This sample routes the shot list to Claude. The step is a careful sequence with the same wardrobe and light, and the example treats that consistency as Claude's job. The model id stays example because no live model was called.
steps.output:
1. Door, interior, shop light clicks off. 4 seconds. Hands only.
2. Door closing from the street. 4 seconds. Singer small in frame.
3. Wet pavement, footsteps, no face. 5 seconds.
4. Profile, mouth closed, one glance down. 5 seconds.
5. Look back at the dark shop. 4 seconds. Small movement.
6. Warm window ahead, singer stops. 4 seconds.
7. Coat and window light, hold. 4 seconds.

All shots: night, one practical window, dark coat, no crowd. Mouth stays mostly closed, so no lip-sync is planned in this sample.

steps.title: Prompts per shot
steps.instructions: Write a short prompt for each shot. Repeat the coat color and the single warm window. Do not ask for a crowd or a dance.
steps.why: This sample routes the prompts to GPT. The step is tight wording that keeps every shot on the same coat and light, and the example treats that prompt writing as GPT's job. The model id stays example because no live model was called.
steps.output:
Use the same line on every prompt: night street, wet pavement, dark wool coat, one warm window, no crowd, calm motion.

Shot 1: interior shop, a hand switches off one lamp, door still open.
Shot 2: street side of a closing door, singer small, coat collar up.
Shot 3: low angle, wet pavement, two slow steps, no face.
Shot 4: profile, mouth closed, eyes down, window light on the coat.
Shot 5: singer looks back once at a dark doorway, then turns away.
Shot 6: singer stops under one warm window, hands in pockets.
Shot 7: hold on coat and window light, almost still.

These are text prompts only. No clip was generated.
